Claude Certified Architect: Professional (CCAR-P) is Anthropic's advanced architect credential. It covers enterprise-scale integration architecture, governance and evaluation.

Below it sits the foundation credential, Claude Certified Architect: Foundations (CCAR-F), for solution architects who design and build agent systems with Claude. Anthropic describes the two as a progression, from foundation level to professional level.

The public overview does not publish the CCAR-P exam blueprint or booking details. So this study note treats secondary exam details as what they are: unverified.
